title: Night architecture
prompt: Create an exceptionally polished 16:9 marketplace campaign thumbnail for Salat Times, a native Omarchy prayer-time plugin. Exact text: 'SALAT TIMES'; supporting text 'Prayer times for Omarchy'; small feature line 'Worldwide • Hijri • Qibla'. Art directed, strong focal point and legible title at small size, intentional composition. No emerald or green, no clock ring, no UI screenshots or imaginary app screens. No extra marketing claims, no watermark. This is one of three design options for user selection. Direction 1: A nocturnal architectural portrait of a luminous Moroccan mosque minaret seen through a huge intricately carved dark arch, very tight editorial crop, deep midnight navy and ink-black shadows, one warm amber source of light; precise cinematic architectural photography, realistic worn stone and subtle brass detail. On the left, large warm-white SALAT TIMES in carefully spaced refined contemporary serif lettering, well-separated from the architecture. A bold asymmetric magazine-cover composition, extremely sophisticated, NOT a generic travel postcard, no clutter. Title dominates the thumbnail; a thin peach typographic rule gives structure.
